open_points.subject: _observation
open_points.text: _observation: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST copy name, size, source_id, status and reason of a source whose status is the REJECTED member of = models.ScanStatus into a SourcePhotoObservation with no file_ref and no photo_id and read no record for it; for a source whose status is the READY member, which _observed always gives a source id, it MUST call read_placement and then read_mark for the project id and that source_id and return the PUBLISHED member of = models.ScanStatus with the file_ref of the placement and the photo_id of the mark when both exist, the PLACED member with that file_ref and no photo_id when only the placement exists, and the READY member with neither otherwise, letting their DelivererError pass.
open_points.question: Must `_observed` be changed to the available `observe_source_files` provenance, or must an `_observed` symbol be added to the imports and contracts?

open_points.subject: deliver_project_photo
open_points.text: deliver_project_photo: [VALIDATION_ERROR] Without a placement it MUST call the imported read_named_source once with the photo folder and the name and answer with _failed: the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure when it returns None; for a SourceFile whose status is the REJECTED member of = models.ScanStatus, which _observed always gives a reason, the failure of the row of the imported OBSERVATION_FAILURES constant whose reason is that reason; the SOURCE_CHANGED member when the lowercase hexadecimal digest of the imported sha256 of the bytes read differs from the source id; the reason of a Rejected that _place raises; and the UNREADABLE_FILE member when _place raises OSError; otherwise it MUST answer the PLACED member with the placement _place returns and no photo_id, leaving any existing mark as it is.
open_points.question: Must `_observed` be replaced by the actual guarantee of imported `read_named_source` or `observe_source_files`, or must an `_observed` symbol be added to the imports and contracts?
